items.line: **`DefaultConfig()`** in [`config.go`](/internal/config/config.go) returns the canonical default `*Config`, moved from the test helper.
items.requirement: The default Flipt configuration must be available through a function `DefaultConfig()` in the config package that takes no arguments and returns a `*Config`, and it must return the same canonical default values used by the configuration loading path.

items.line: **`DecodeHooks`**, exported from the same file, is the one list of string-to-value conversions. `Load` and the schema test both use it.
items.requirement: The configuration decode hook chain must be reusable through the exported `DecodeHooks` value in the config package, so decoding the default configuration into a `map[string]any` uses the same conversions as normal configuration loading.

items.line: | Normal     | A duration has a fraction, such as `1.5s`                          | The pattern accepts it, since `time.Duration` produces such strings                  |
items.requirement: Every duration setting of the configuration must be accepted by the CUE schema when written in Go's duration string form, the form a `time.Duration` value takes when converted to a string.
The CUE configuration schema must expose a top-level `#FliptSpec` definition that can be used to validate decoded Flipt configuration maps.

`#FliptSpec` must accept every top-level section emitted by the decoded default configuration, including `log`, `ui`, `cors`, `cache`, `server`, `tracing`, `db`, `meta`, `authentication`, `audit`, `experimental`, and `storage`.

items.line: **The tags and `fieldKey`** name each mapstructure field as the schema does. `fieldKey` returns the tag's name when the attribute is `omitempty`.
items.requirement: Mapstructure field names must align with the schema field names used for validation, and `omitempty` options in mapstructure tags must not prevent the correct field name from being used.

items.line: Optional fields whose default is empty carry `omitempty`, so they are absent from the map.
items.requirement: Optional fields that are empty in the default configuration must not cause CUE validation failures, including optional nested fields in authentication, database, storage, tracing, audit, and other configuration sections.

items.line: | Normal     | `storage.git.authentication` is omitted or empty                   | The schema accepts both, and no empty `basic` or `token` object is emitted           |
items.requirement: Storage configuration must support omitted `local`, `git`, and authentication subsections without emitting invalid empty objects during default configuration validation.

items.line: **`StorageConfig`** in [`storage.go`](/internal/config/storage.go) holds `Local *Local` and `Git *Git`, nil unless selected.
items.requirement: `StorageConfig.Local` and `StorageConfig.Git` must become nil-able pointer fields, typed `*Local` and `*Git`, nil when the backend is not selected, carrying the supplied settings when selected, omitted from the decoded configuration; deliberate breaking change; source covered must continue to build, construction sites outside the change's scope are reconciled elsewhere.

items.line: **Given** `storage.type` `git` with `repository`, `ref` `production`, `poll_interval` `5s`, and `authentication.basic` of `user` and `pass`, **When** validated, **Then** it passes.
items.requirement: The CUE schema must accept storage configurations for database, git, and local storage, including git repository settings, refs, poll intervals, and either basic or token authentication when provided.

items.line: **The URL form needs only `url`.** The parts form needs all five fields. Either form accepts the shared options: password, connection limits, connection lifetime, and prepared statements.
items.requirement: Database configuration validation must accept either a URL-based configuration or a protocol, host, port, name, and user based configuration, while still allowing shared database options such as password, connection limits, connection lifetime, and prepared statement settings.

items.line: **Given** `cors.allowed_origins` is the string `foo.com`, then the list `["foo.com", "bar.com"]`, **When** each is validated, **Then** both pass.
items.requirement: CORS configuration must accept `allowed_origins` as either a list of origins or a single string.

items.line: **Given** `advanced.yml`, **When** it is loaded, **Then** `Storage.Type` is `git` and `Storage.Local` is nil. `Storage.Git` has `Repository` `https://github.com/flipt-io/flipt.git`, `Ref` `production`, `PollInterval` 5s, and basic authentication of `user` and `pass`.
items.requirement: The config package's fully populated example configuration document `advanced.yml` must be extended to also cover audit, tracing OTLP, and git storage sections with the exact values given.

items.line: **SC-001** (no CUE errors): `DefaultConfig()`, decoded and converted, validates against `#FliptSpec` with `cue.Concrete(true)` and no error.
items.requirement: The configuration returned by `DefaultConfig()`, with its durations in string form, must validate against `#FliptSpec` without errors when every value is required to be concrete.

items.line: **SC-003** (equality): loading an empty file with no `FLIPT_` variables equals `DefaultConfig()`.
items.requirement: The default Flipt configuration must be available through `DefaultConfig()` in the config package, and it must return the same canonical default values used by the configuration loading path.

items.line: **Given** that decoded map before conversion, **When** the cache TTL is read, **Then** it is a `time.Duration` of one minute. After conversion it is the string `1m0s`.
items.requirement: Decoding `DefaultConfig()` with `mapstructure.ComposeDecodeHookFunc(DecodeHooks...)` must preserve duration fields as `time.Duration` values before schema validation adaptation.

items.line: **Given** the default configuration, **When** its durations are converted to strings, **Then** they read `24h0m0s` (token lifetime), `10m0s` (state lifetime), `1m0s` (cache TTL), `5m0s` (cache eviction interval), and `2m0s` (audit flush period).
items.requirement: Duration values emitted from the default configuration must be valid after conversion to their string form, including values such as `1m0s`, `24h0m0s`, `10m0s`, `5m0s`, and `2m0s`.

items.line: **Given** `advanced.yml`, **When** it is loaded, **Then** `Audit.Sinks.LogFile` is enabled with `File` `/path/to/logs.txt`, and `Audit.Buffer` has `Capacity` 10 and `FlushPeriod` 3m.
items.requirement: The example configuration document `advanced.yml` must be extended so that it also exercises the sections this change introduces or reshapes, and load into exactly the audit, tracing, and storage values given.

items.line: **Given** `DefaultConfig()`, **When** it is decoded to a `map[string]any` with `DecodeHooks` and validated against `#FliptSpec` with `cue.Concrete(true)`, **Then** CUE reports no error.
items.requirement: Validating the decoded and adapted `DefaultConfig()` map against `#FliptSpec` with concrete CUE validation must complete without errors.
